name: When should I consider railing replacement instead of just repair?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider railing replacement instead of just repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider railing replacement if the damage is widespread, structural integrity is compromised, or if the cost of repair approaches or exceeds the cost of a new installation. Extensive rot, severe corrosion, or significant structural weakening often warrant replacement to ensure long-term safety and durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacement for widespread damage, compromised structure, or high repair costs.
